Feature: Prescription Management Workflow

  Scenario: Each Patient Consultation Request Generates ONE prescription
    Given a Patient Consultation Request is created
    When the system processes the request
    Then exactly one prescription is generated

  Scenario: Prescription is mapped to ONE AND ONLY ONE Patient Consultation Request
    Given a prescription is generated from a Patient Consultation Request
    When the system maps the prescription
    Then the prescription is mapped to exactly one Patient Consultation Request

  Scenario Outline: Each Chemist receives one or more prescriptions (only required fields)
    Given a Chemist with pincode <pincode>
    When the system sends prescriptions to the Chemist
    Then the Chemist receives <number_of_prescriptions> prescriptions
    Examples:
      | pincode | number_of_prescriptions |
      | 12345   | 1                       |
      | 67890   | 2                       |
      | 54321   | 0                       | # Edge case: No prescriptions

  Scenario Outline: Each prescription is mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Chemist
    Given a prescription is generated
    When the system maps the prescription to a Chemist with pincode <pincode>
    Then the prescription is mapped to exactly one Chemist with pincode <pincode>
    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 12345   |
      | 67890   |

  Scenario Outline: Each Lab receives one or more prescriptions (only required fields)
    Given a Lab with pincode <pincode>
    When the system sends prescriptions to the Lab
    Then the Lab receives <number_of_prescriptions> prescriptions
    Examples:
      | pincode | number_of_prescriptions |
      | 11111   | 1                       |
      | 22222   | 3                       |
      | 33333   | 0                       | # Edge case: No prescriptions

  Scenario Outline: Each prescription is mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Lab
    Given a prescription is generated
    When the system maps the prescription to a Lab with pincode <pincode>
    Then the prescription is mapped to exactly one Lab with pincode <pincode>
    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 11111   |
      | 22222   |
